newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active on Tuesday, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher than last week, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand good. Sales confirmed on 33,100 slaughter steers and 33,200 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 78,200 head confirmed including 14,900 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs mostly 1150-1200 lbs 69.00; couple pens Select with end Choice 68.00; few Select and Choice 1200 lb Holsteins 61.00. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1200- 1225 lbs 111.00, hot weights, delivered.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1175 lbs mostly 1000-1075 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00; few Select with end Choice 1050 lbs 68.00- 69.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1150-1300 lb heifers and heiferettes including few cows 66.00-68.50. Dressed basis - few 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 111.00, hot weights delivered.
Wk to date - 78,200 last week - 7,600 last year - 3,300
